svg.text: Autonomics — DAG-based dispatch with ephemeral, containerized analysis nodes
typed DAG plans the work • JSON-Schema-validated nodes • Podman-isolated execution • SHA-256-verified artifacts
DAG engine plans + dispatches analysis as a typed DAG;
each node is JSON-Schema-validated and runs in its own ephemeral
Podman container with read-only panel mounts and SHA-256 artifact fingerprints.
External tools wrapped as Podman containers;
one-shot ephemeral runs; image digest pinned.
Declared outputs streamed to VFS; FileRef = size
container_command lifecycle (one ephemeral run per node)
Copy File / Data values from VFS
Check exit code and capped stdout /
fail if any declared output is missing
one container_command = one ephemeral run; no retry on container failure
PLINK2, DESeq2, PyRadiomics, sc, viz, TimesFM
all bundles are Cargo feature-gated; default build enables all
what makes a container node reproducible and isolated
CPU / PID / shm / UID / GID caps
VFS write stages to a sibling object;
rename only after the full payload
shared data plane (VFS + DataFusion catalog + bio-format readers) backs the panel
fire-and-forget so long runs don't block agents
each external tool runs in its own
the same DAG mixes fast in-process
recorded spec, code path, image digest,
